basic_profile.bio: Living in Detroit, I'm a 29-year-old music enthusiast and reality TV aficionado. I work as a graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my passion for rock music and follow my favorite shows like 'The Masked Singer'. I'm usually online during evenings and weekends, after work and band practice. I'm single and enjoy spending my downtime exploring new music and keeping up with my favorite sports team, the Detroit Red Wings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from UMGC, and I've been playing guitar in a local band for the past five years. My love for music spans across various genres, with a particular interest in rock. I also enjoy analyzing reality TV shows, often discussing theories and sharing insights with fellow fans.
